source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Your **LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH** units have **Seductive Gambit**: after such a unit finishes a Charge move, you may declare a Seductive Gambit for it. Until the turn ends, a unit that does:

- Loses [Fights First](vsdata:core-ability/fights-first).
- May re-roll Hit rolls for its models' attacks.
- May re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its models' attacks.
